newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Southern, CNAC seen seeking HK listings in Q3.
newsitem.headline: China Southern, CNAC seen seeking HK listings in Q3.

text.p: China Southern Airline and China National Aviation Corporation (CNAC) are expected to seek listings in Hong Kong during the third quarter of 1997, market sources said on Thursday.
Sources said they were not sure which issue would come first to the market and added that few listing details about the two issues were available.
Goldman Sachs is expected to be the sponor for China Southern, sources said. Goldman Sachs officials were not immediately available for comment.

China Southern's major operations are routes between domestic Chinese destinations including Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Guangzhou. The airline is expected to expand into international services, sources said.
Market sources said the state-owned aviation group CNAC was also expected to seek a listing in the next few months. Peregrine and BZW are expected to be the sponsors of the issue.

CNAC, a division of China's regulatory authority, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, is the largest single shareholder in Hong Kong Dragon Airlines after it bought about 36 percent of Hong Kong carrier last year.
